pre_b3_solo_1.text: Darius, we are under the ice shell of Europa. It is freezing, dark, and filled with ancient machinery.

pre_b3_solo_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_solo_2.text: Objective: Navigate the frozen machinery, defeat the Cyber Coelacanth, and extract the GLYPH-3 Memory Integration core.

pre_b3_solo_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_solo_3.text: Threats: Heavy walker mechs on ceiling tracks, Sentinels, and Sparker drones leaving electric trails.

pre_b3_solo_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_solo_4.text: Pilot, you're our only hope. The Navy is closing in. Find that core so we can start decoding Ophion's records. Good hunting.

pre_b3_coop2_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_coop2_1.text: Darius, Valera, keep your thrusters warm. We're in the deep vents beneath Europa's ice sheet.

pre_b3_coop2_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_coop2_2.text: Objective: Penetrate the ancient nesting grounds, defeat the Cyber Coelacanth, and secure GLYPH-3.

pre_b3_coop2_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_coop2_3.text: Threats: Ceiling walker juggernauts, sparkers, and stationary sentinels. Watch out for arcing electrical currents.

pre_b3_coop2_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_coop2_4.text: You two are the best we've got. The Navy has sent a probe team nearby. Grab that core before they pin us down.

pre_b3_coop4_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_coop4_1.text: Squadron, listen up. We are in the birthing chambers of the Coelacanth network beneath Europa's ice shell.

pre_b3_coop4_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_coop4_2.text: Objective: Defeat the primary Cyber Coelacanth dreadnought and secure the GLYPH-3 Memory Integration core.

pre_b3_coop4_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_coop4_3.text: Threats: Sparkers, Juggernauts, and automated defenses. The cold will slow your shield recharge rates.

pre_b3_coop4_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b3_coop4_4.text: Lyra's condition is shifting. We need this piece of the puzzle immediately. Keep coordinates aligned. Break orbit!

pre_b4_solo_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_solo_1.text: Darius, we've broken orbit and entered the Veil Nebula. Comms are cracking under high electromagnetic storms.

pre_b4_solo_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_solo_2.text: Objective: Navigate the gas clouds, locate the fourth Coelacanth, and extract the GLYPH-4 Psychic Dampener.

pre_b4_solo_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_solo_3.text: Threats: Watch out for phase-shifting Plasma Wisps and Nebula Wraiths that can pass through solid obstacles.

pre_b4_solo_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_solo_4.text: Pilot, you're our only hope. The cosmic gas itself feels alive down there. Keep your head on straight, son. Thorne out.

pre_b4_coop2_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_coop2_1.text: Darius, Valera, welcome to the deep void. Comms are garbled but readable.

pre_b4_coop2_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_coop2_2.text: Objective: Track the signal of the fourth Coelacanth and retrieve the GLYPH-4 Psychic Dampener.

pre_b4_coop2_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_coop2_3.text: Threats: Storm Sprites with chain-lightning attacks and heavy Gas Giants that absorb bullets from the front.

pre_b4_coop2_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_coop2_4.text: You two are the best we've got. The environment is shifting based on neural patterns. Do not lose your focus.

pre_b4_coop4_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_coop4_1.text: Squadron, listen up. We are deep in the Veil Nebula. The Abyss Mind is dreaming this gas cloud into a weapon.

pre_b4_coop4_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_coop4_2.text: Objective: Defeat the Nebula Serpent, secure GLYPH-4, and escape before the storm collapses.

pre_b4_coop4_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_coop4_3.text: Threats: Phase-shifting plasma wisps, storm sprites, and cloaked nebula wraiths. Visual range is limited.

pre_b4_coop4_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b4_coop4_4.text: Lyra's neural scans are showing spikes matching this nebula's resonance. Get this dampener. Thorne out.

pre_b5_solo_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_solo_1.text: Darius, we've dropped into Saturn's rings. The ice shards are dense, and we've got a massive problem.

pre_b5_solo_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_solo_2.text: Objective: Navigate the freezing debris, defeat the Frost Wyrm, and extract the GLYPH-5 Cellular Regulator.

pre_b5_solo_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_solo_3.text: Threats: Swarming Ice Drones, Frost Interceptors, and the Navy's elite Squadron Umbra interceptors.

pre_b5_solo_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_solo_4.text: Pilot, you're our only hope. Valera Cross is commanding the Navy force. She has orders to terminate you. Watch your back.

pre_b5_coop2_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_coop2_1.text: Darius, Valera, this is it. The Navy has blocked the exit vectors in the rings.

pre_b5_coop2_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_coop2_2.text: Objective: Defeat the Frost Wyrm, retrieve the GLYPH-5 Cellular Regulator, and disable the Navy blockers.

pre_b5_coop2_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_coop2_3.text: Threats: Spinning Ice Shards, Frost Drones with freeze beams, and Squadron Umbra strike ships.

pre_b5_coop2_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_coop2_4.text: You two are the best we've got. Valera, Crane's orders are fake—he's using your squad as bait. Trust Darius and clear the path.

pre_b5_coop4_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_coop4_1.text: Squadron, listen up. We are surrounded by ice rings and the Navy's heavy fleet blockade.

pre_b5_coop4_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_coop4_2.text: Objective: Secure the GLYPH-5 Cellular Regulator from the Frost Wyrm and punch a hole through the Navy blockade.

pre_b5_coop4_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_coop4_3.text: Threats: Frost drones, glaciers that explode into ice needles on death, and elite Navy interceptors.

pre_b5_coop4_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b5_coop4_4.text: Valera has defected to our side, but Admiral Crane is sending reinforcements. Fight together, or we freeze here. Go!

pre_b6_solo_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_solo_1.text: Darius, we are in the Betelgeuse Remnant. The ambient temperature is off the charts. We've got bad news from Haven-7.

pre_b6_solo_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_solo_2.text: Objective: Navigate the volcanic cluster, defeat the Inferno Titan, and retrieve the GLYPH-6 Thermal Stabilizer.

pre_b6_solo_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_solo_3.text: Threats: Watch out for Ember Sprites leaving burning trails and Magma Wasps that explode on impact.

pre_b6_solo_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_solo_4.text: Pilot, you're our only hope. The Navy attacked Haven-7 during the warp, and Lyra's attunement has spiked. Stay focused, son.

pre_b6_coop2_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_coop2_1.text: Darius, Valera, comms are fluctuating under the thermal haze. This nebula is a living furnace.

pre_b6_coop2_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_coop2_2.text: Objective: Navigate the Betelgeuse Remnant, destroy the Inferno Titan, and secure GLYPH-6.

pre_b6_coop2_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_coop2_3.text: Threats: Molten Lava Golems forming hazard pools, magma wasps, and extreme heat distortion.

pre_b6_coop2_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_coop2_4.text: You two are the best we've got. The Navy has boarded Haven-7. Naya is holding them off, but Lyra is changing. Move fast!

pre_b6_coop4_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_coop4_1.text: Squadron, listen up. Haven-7 has been breached. Selene and Naya evacuated, but Lyra was exposed to the Navy's signal accelerator.

pre_b6_coop4_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_coop4_2.text: Objective: Defeat the Inferno Titan (the Forge-Mind), secure GLYPH-6, and return to the evacuation coordinates.

pre_b6_coop4_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_coop4_3.text: Threats: High-density magma wasps, lava golems, and superheated plasma storms. Shield efficiency is down by 30%.

pre_b6_coop4_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b6_coop4_4.text: The Forge-Mind is actively broadcasting the Dreamer's signal. Shut it down before Lyra's mind is fully overwritten. Go!

pre_b7_solo_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_solo_1.text: Darius, we're in the atmosphere of HD 189733b. The winds are hitting 5,000 miles per hour, and lightning is constant.

pre_b7_solo_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_solo_2.text: Objective: Fly through the hurricane, defeat the Tempest Colossus, and extract the GLYPH-7 Atmospheric Interface.

pre_b7_solo_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_solo_3.text: Threats: Watch out for Storm Hawks with EMP attacks that can temporarily disable your weapons.

pre_b7_solo_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_solo_4.text: Pilot, you're our only hope. The seventh Coelacanth is mad. Decades in this storm broke its program. End its suffering, son.

pre_b7_coop2_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_coop2_1.text: Darius, Valera, maintain tight vector stabilization. These crosswinds will drag you into the debris field.

pre_b7_coop2_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_coop2_2.text: Objective: Navigate the storm core, defeat the Tempest Colossus, and retrieve the GLYPH-7 interface.

pre_b7_coop2_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_coop2_3.text: Threats: Static Sparks, Storm Hawks with EMP bursts, and stationary Storm Sentinels projecting lightning barriers.

pre_b7_coop2_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_coop2_4.text: You two are the best we've got. Naya is monitoring Lyra's vitals. The storm's electrical energy is keeping her stable. Stay focused.

pre_b7_coop4_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_coop4_1.text: Squadron, listen up. We are descending into the eye of the eternal hurricane on HD 189733b.

pre_b7_coop4_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_coop4_2.text: Objective: Defeat the corrupted Storm-Singer (Tempest Colossus) and secure the GLYPH-7 Atmospheric Interface.

pre_b7_coop4_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_coop4_3.text: Threats: EMP storms, static sparks, and rotating lightning walls. Navigation systems will occasionally glitch.

pre_b7_coop4_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b7_coop4_4.text: We need this interface to decode the precursor logs. The Storm-Singer is trapped in a loop of madness. Free it, squadron. Out.

pre_b8_solo_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_solo_1.text: Darius, we've dropped into the ship graveyard. Hundreds of abandoned Navy vessels. The ghosts of Project Dream-Weapon.

pre_b8_solo_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_solo_2.text: Objective: Search the wreckage, defeat the Dreadnought AI, and retrieve the GLYPH-8 Genetic Matrix.

pre_b8_solo_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_solo_3.text: Threats: Salvage Drones, Ghost Fighters on autopilot, and active deck turrets popping out of wreckage.

pre_b8_solo_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_solo_4.text: Pilot, you're our only hope. Admiral Crane's psychic imprint is running the system. The truth about your family is here. Go, son.

pre_b8_coop2_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_coop2_1.text: Darius, Valera, watch the debris. These hulks still have automated defense grids active.

pre_b8_coop2_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_coop2_2.text: Objective: Infiltrate the flagship NSS Event Horizon, defeat the Dreadnought AI, and extract the GLYPH-8 Genetic Matrix.

pre_b8_coop2_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_coop2_3.text: Threats: Kamikaze salvage drones, ghost fighters, and heavy turret batteries firing synchronized volleys.

pre_b8_coop2_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_coop2_4.text: You two are the best we've got. The logs in this fleet will reveal why the Navy targeted the Star bloodline. Find the core.

pre_b8_coop4_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_coop4_1.text: Squadron, listen up. We are flying through the graveyard of the Navy's secret armada.

pre_b8_coop4_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_coop4_2.text: Objective: Secure the GLYPH-8 Genetic Matrix from the Dreadnought AI and retrieve the project records.

pre_b8_coop4_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_coop4_3.text: Threats: Automated turrets, salvage drones, and ghost fighter swarms. The debris field makes navigation hazardous.

pre_b8_coop4_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b8_coop4_4.text: Ophion's AI is scanning the network. Admiral Crane's digital ghost is defending the core. Wipe him out, squadron.

pre_b9_solo_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_solo_1.text: Darius, we've arrived at Proxima Centauri B. It's a nightmare. The planet has been entirely reshaped into flesh and bones.

pre_b9_solo_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_solo_2.text: Objective: Navigate the fleshy tunnels, defeat the Hive Mind, and retrieve the GLYPH-9 Consciousness Anchor.

pre_b9_solo_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_solo_3.text: Threats: Wall-crawling Crawlers, Spitters firing acidic globs, and armored Brutes. Destroy Hive Nodes to stop spawns.

pre_b9_solo_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_solo_4.text: Pilot, you're our only hope. The Hive is trying to negotiate with you, offering Lyra's safety for your surrender. Don't listen to its lies.

pre_b9_coop2_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_coop2_1.text: Darius, Valera, the atmosphere here is organic and acidic. Keep your shields at maximum polarity.

pre_b9_coop2_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_coop2_2.text: Objective: Infiltrate the Hive core, defeat the Hive Mind nexus, and secure the GLYPH-9 Consciousness Anchor.

pre_b9_coop2_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_coop2_3.text: Threats: Acidic spitters (DoT damage), skittering crawlers, and armored brutes. Watch out for shifting organic walls.

pre_b9_coop2_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_coop2_4.text: You two are the best we've got. The Hive is using Lyra's voice to lure you into a trap. Keep your focus on the objective.

pre_b9_coop4_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_coop4_1.text: Squadron, listen up. Proxima Centauri B is a fully 'Dreamed' world. The Abyss Mind has rewritten its physics.

pre_b9_coop4_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_coop4_2.text: Objective: Penetrate the hive nexus, destroy the Hive Mind, and extract the GLYPH-9 Consciousness Anchor.

pre_b9_coop4_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_coop4_3.text: Threats: Spitters with high acidic damage, wall crawlers, and spawning hive nodes. Gravity will warp occasionally.

pre_b9_coop4_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b9_coop4_4.text: Ophion's AI is warning us that this is what happens when the containment fails. We must stop this infestation. Move in!

pre_b10_solo_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_solo_1.text: Darius, we've arrived at the galactic center. The supermassive black hole is right below us. Space and time are breaking apart.

pre_b10_solo_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_solo_2.text: Objective: Navigate the reality cracks, defeat The Architect, and secure the GLYPH-10 Integration Core.

pre_b10_solo_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_solo_3.text: Threats: Glitch Fragments, Paradox Wisps moving in reverse, Null Entities, and Void Maws that pull you in.

pre_b10_solo_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_solo_4.text: Darius... you have all nine components. Once you secure the tenth, the final choice is yours. Save your daughter, son. Thorne out.

pre_b10_coop2_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_coop2_1.text: Darius, Valera, comms are failing. We are at the event horizon of oblivion.

pre_b10_coop2_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_coop2_2.text: Objective: Defeat The Architect, retrieve the GLYPH-10 Integration Core, and decide the fate of the galaxy.

pre_b10_coop2_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_coop2_3.text: Threats: Glitch fragments, paradox wisps, null entities erasing bullets, and void maw gravity wells (instant death).

pre_b10_coop2_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_coop2_4.text: You two are the best we've got. The final barrier is ahead. Trust your training, trust each other, and make your decision.

pre_b10_coop4_1.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_coop4_1.text: Squadron, listen up. This is the end of the line. The Prime Coelacanth is collapsing into the event horizon.

pre_b10_coop4_2.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_coop4_2.text: Objective: Destroy The Architect, secure the GLYPH-10 Integration Core, and initiate the final protocol.

pre_b10_coop4_3.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_coop4_3.text: Threats: Shifting geometry Rift Aberrations, void maws, and severe UI corruption glitches.

pre_b10_coop4_4.speaker: thorne
pre_b10_coop4_4.text: Whatever you choose at the core, we are with you. Naya, Valera, Ophion, Darius... save our girl. Thorne out.

banter_db_darius_then_every_timeline_end.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_then_every_timeline_end.text: Then every timeline ends with us breaking through the cycle.

banter_db_lyra_the_timeline_is_looping_d.speaker: lyra
banter_db_lyra_the_timeline_is_looping_d.text: The timeline is looping, Daddy! But our weapons are tuned from our last run!

banter_db_thorne_paradox_enemies_inbound.speaker: thorne
banter_db_thorne_paradox_enemies_inbound.text: Paradox enemies inbound! They remember our tactics—switch up attack vectors!

banter_db_naya_quantum_fabricator_has_re.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_quantum_fabricator_has_re.text: Quantum fabricator has retained full blueprint memory. Sweep the sector clean.

banter_db_thorne_blow_the_kraken_generat.speaker: thorne
banter_db_thorne_blow_the_kraken_generat.text: Blow the kraken generators on the fly. Second time's the charm.

banter_db_darius_let_it_upgrade_our_quan.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_let_it_upgrade_our_quan.text: Let it upgrade. Our quantum dodad has higher output this loop.

banter_db_cross_overload_his_processing_.speaker: cross
banter_db_cross_overload_his_processing_.text: Overload his processing core before he reconciles the timeline paradox.

banter_db_darius_not_entropy_architect_p.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_not_entropy_architect_p.text: Not entropy, Architect. Purpose. All ships, engage the Cyber Coelacanth!

banter_engine_darius_another_plate_the_n.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_another_plate_the_n.text: Another plate. The Nyxa appreciates it.

banter_engine_naya_salvage_logged_every_.speaker: naya
banter_engine_naya_salvage_logged_every_.text: Salvage logged. Every credit counts toward the next push.

banter_engine_naya_milestone_hit_we_are_.speaker: naya
banter_engine_naya_milestone_hit_we_are_.text: Milestone hit. We are not broke yet.

banter_engine_darius_essence_plate_pre_w.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_essence_plate_pre_w.text: Essence plate! Pre-war alloy. Worth more than a fleet destroyer.

banter_engine_naya_legendary_drop_that_p.speaker: naya
banter_engine_naya_legendary_drop_that_p.text: LEGENDARY drop! That piece alone would buy a week of station time.

banter_engine_naya_an_essence_fragment_d.speaker: naya
banter_engine_naya_an_essence_fragment_d.text: An essence fragment. Dreamer signature confirmed in the alloy.

banter_engine_naya_upgrade_installed_sho.speaker: naya
banter_engine_naya_upgrade_installed_sho.text: Upgrade installed. Should help with what is ahead.

banter_engine_thorne_good_investment_tha.speaker: thorne
banter_engine_thorne_good_investment_tha.text: Good investment. That system will earn its keep.

banter_engine_naya_max_rank_upgrade_that.speaker: naya
banter_engine_naya_max_rank_upgrade_that.text: MAX rank upgrade! That system is fully tuned now.

banter_engine_darius_top_of_the_line_not.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_top_of_the_line_not.text: Top of the line. Nothing in the trench can match this.

banter_engine_naya_maximum_calibration_a.speaker: naya
banter_engine_naya_maximum_calibration_a.text: Maximum calibration achieved. Upgrade branch complete.

banter_engine_darius_glad_you_made_it_th.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_glad_you_made_it_th.text: Glad you made it. This trench doesn't explore itself.

banter_engine_naya_another_pilot_we_coul.speaker: naya
banter_engine_naya_another_pilot_we_coul.text: Another pilot. We could use the help down here.

banter_engine_darius_just_in_time_the_he.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_just_in_time_the_he.text: Just in time. The heavy fighting's about to start.

banter_engine_darius_right_on_schedule_t.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_right_on_schedule_t.text: Right on schedule. Things are heating up.

banter_engine_naya_never_too_late_to_joi.speaker: naya
banter_engine_naya_never_too_late_to_joi.text: Never too late to join the fight!

banter_engine_cross_one_less_gun_we_adap.speaker: cross
banter_engine_cross_one_less_gun_we_adap.text: One less gun. We adapt. We always do.

dialogue_scenes_thorne_darius_our_therma.speaker: thorne
dialogue_scenes_thorne_darius_our_therma.text: Darius, our thermal readings show the left channel is stable. Stay on course.

dialogue_scenes_darius_override_decision.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_override_decision.text: Override decision required. Which channel do we take?

dialogue_scenes_lyra_the_center_opens_up.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_the_center_opens_up.text: The center opens up in about forty meters. There's a hidden cave — precursor construction. You can slip through. I can... feel the shape of it.

dialogue_scenes_lyra_follow_the_blue_glo.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_follow_the_blue_glo.text: Follow the blue glow. Not the bright one — the dim one, way down low. It's not trying to trick you.

dialogue_scenes_thorne_error_left_channe.speaker: thorne
dialogue_scenes_thorne_error_left_channe.text: Error! Left channel thermal readings spiking! Pull out, Darius!

dialogue_scenes_lyra_daddy_get_out_of_th.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_daddy_get_out_of_th.text: Daddy! Get out of there! Veer center now! The blue glow!

dialogue_scenes_darius_steering_center_c.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_steering_center_c.text: Steering center... Coral cave spotted. We're in, but took heavy damage.

dialogue_scenes_thorne_all_primary_escap.speaker: thorne
dialogue_scenes_thorne_all_primary_escap.text: All primary escape routes are sealed. I'm calculating secondary vectors...

dialogue_scenes_thorne_negative_lyra_dow.speaker: thorne
dialogue_scenes_thorne_negative_lyra_dow.text: Negative, Lyra. Down is the substrate layer. Solid bedrock for three kilometers. There's nothing down there.

dialogue_scenes_lyra_not_solid_not_anymo.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_not_solid_not_anymo.text: Not solid. Not anymore. The Dreamer... it dreamed through it. There's a vein. A hollow vein. Like a crack in a tooth. You can fit.

dialogue_scenes_lyra_i_can_feel_the_wate.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_i_can_feel_the_wate.text: I can feel the water moving through it. It's real, Daddy. I promise.

dialogue_scenes_lyra_i_told_you_i_can_fe.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_i_told_you_i_can_fe.text: I told you. I can feel the shape of things.

dialogue_scenes_darius_cannot_risk_smash.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_cannot_risk_smash.text: Cannot risk smashing solid bedrock. Thorne, give me that secondary vector!

dialogue_scenes_lyra_daddy_the_wall_is_f.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_daddy_the_wall_is_f.text: Daddy! The wall is falling! You have to go down, please!

dialogue_scenes_darius_fine_heading_down.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_fine_heading_down.text: Fine! Heading down! Bedrock is... hollow! We are inside the vein!

dialogue_scenes_lyra_daddy_the_ice_shard.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_daddy_the_ice_shard.text: Daddy — the ice shard at bearing 217. The big one, the one that looks like a broken tooth. Fly INTO it.

dialogue_scenes_darius_umbra_fighters_lo.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_umbra_fighters_lo.text: Umbra fighters locking missiles. Do we trust Lyra or engage?

dialogue_scenes_lyra_i_can_see_the_path_.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_i_can_see_the_path_.text: I can see the path in my head. Left fork in twenty meters... now!

dialogue_scenes_lyra_slow_down_for_the_n.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_slow_down_for_the_n.text: Slow down for the next chamber — there's something resting in there, don't wake it...

dialogue_scenes_lyra_surface_exit_in_thr.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_surface_exit_in_thr.text: Surface exit in three hundred meters. Cross is waiting on the far side, but she doesn't know which exit you'll take. Pick the northern one.

dialogue_scenes_darius_exiting_northern_.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_exiting_northern_.text: Exiting northern corridor! We are clear. Cross is out of position!

dialogue_scenes_lyra_daddy_shields_are_f.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_daddy_shields_are_f.text: Daddy! Shields are failing! Get into the ice cavern, it's the only way!

dialogue_scenes_darius_too_many_of_them_.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_too_many_of_them_.text: Too many of them! Banking into the shard fissure!

dialogue_scenes_lyra_left_fork_now_then_.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_left_fork_now_then_.text: Left fork... now! Then right turn. Exiting North!

dialogue_scenes_darius_wake_up_soon_star.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_wake_up_soon_star.text: Wake up soon, starlight. I don

dialogue_scenes_lyra_i_had_to_go_deep_to.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_i_had_to_go_deep_to.text: I had to go deep to come back. I saw everything. The Dreamer isn't trying to hurt us. It's trapped in a loop of its own fear. Like a whale tangled in a net, thrashing, and we're the plankton.

dialogue_scenes_lyra_the_hive_is_going_t.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_the_hive_is_going_t.text: The Hive is going to try to confuse you. It'll show you routes that look safe. They're traps. Let me guide you. Please.

biome_data_lyra_daddy_the_reef_is_lighti.speaker: lyra
biome_data_lyra_daddy_the_reef_is_lighti.text: Daddy, the reef is lighting up... it

biome_data_darius_i_hear_music_from_home.speaker: darius
biome_data_darius_i_hear_music_from_home.text: I hear music from home. Stay sharp, it

biome_data_lyra_the_vault_doors_are_open.speaker: lyra
biome_data_lyra_the_vault_doors_are_open.text: The vault doors are opening, Daddy... they

biome_data_darius_ride_the_warm_updrafts.speaker: darius
biome_data_darius_ride_the_warm_updrafts.text: Ride the warm updrafts from the fissure. It

biome_data_cross_navy_survey_team_was_wi.speaker: cross
biome_data_cross_navy_survey_team_was_wi.text: Navy survey team was wiped here in

biome_data_darius_the_veil_nebula_the_st.speaker: darius
biome_data_darius_the_veil_nebula_the_st.text: The Veil Nebula. The stars look like they

biome_data_lyra_the_nebula_wants_to_tell.speaker: lyra
biome_data_lyra_the_nebula_wants_to_tell.text: The nebula wants to tell us a story, Daddy. It

biome_data_cross_kraken_fortress_sighted.speaker: cross
biome_data_cross_kraken_fortress_sighted.text: Kraken Fortress sighted. This was Crane

biome_data_cross_those_point_defense_tur.speaker: cross
biome_data_cross_those_point_defense_tur.text: Those point-defense turrets are still hunting on Admiral Crane

biome_data_cross_heavy_automated_dreadno.speaker: cross
biome_data_cross_heavy_automated_dreadno.text: Heavy automated dreadnought on patrol. It hasn

biome_data_lyra_daddy_the_walls_are_whis.speaker: lyra
biome_data_lyra_daddy_the_walls_are_whis.text: Daddy... the walls are whispering in Mom

biome_data_thorne_destroy_the_neural_bri.speaker: thorne
biome_data_thorne_destroy_the_neural_bri.text: Destroy the neural bridge nodes. It

biome_data_darius_i_see_ships_from_every.speaker: darius
biome_data_darius_i_see_ships_from_every.text: I see ships from every timeline flying alongside us. We

biome_data_lyra_the_spires_are_singing_t.speaker: lyra
biome_data_lyra_the_spires_are_singing_t.text: The spires are singing the first song of creation. We

dialogue_scenes_lyra_daddy_don_t_go_left.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_daddy_don_t_go_left.text: Daddy... don't go left. The vents — they're going to blow in sequence. Left channel first, then right, then the center. If you go left you'll be in the middle of it.

dialogue_scenes_darius_thorne_i_m_overri.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_thorne_i_m_overri.text: Thorne, I'm overriding. Taking the center channel.

dialogue_scenes_thorne_center_s_a_dead_e.speaker: thorne
dialogue_scenes_thorne_center_s_a_dead_e.text: Center's a dead end, the coral formations —

dialogue_scenes_darius_thorne_s_the_prof.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_thorne_s_the_prof.text: Thorne's the professional. Sticking to the charted left channel.

dialogue_scenes_darius_lyra_s_reading_ma.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_lyra_s_reading_ma.text: Lyra's reading matches no scans, but Thorne's exit is blocked. Where do we go?

dialogue_scenes_cross_you_re_boxed_star_.speaker: cross
dialogue_scenes_cross_you_re_boxed_star_.text: You're boxed, Star. Three squadrons converging on your position. Surrender the components and I'll let you walk.

dialogue_scenes_darius_lyra_that_s_a_sol.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_lyra_that_s_a_sol.text: Lyra, that's a solid ice mass. I'll pancake.

dialogue_scenes_lyra_no_it_s_hollow_the_.speaker: lyra
dialogue_scenes_lyra_no_it_s_hollow_the_.text: No. It's hollow. The Dreamer dreamed a cavity inside. A tunnel network. I can see the whole path. Please.

dialogue_scenes_darius_i_m_not_running_l.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_i_m_not_running_l.text: I'm not running. Let's see how good Squadron Umbra really is.

dialogue_scenes_thorne_without_lyra_s_na.speaker: thorne
dialogue_scenes_thorne_without_lyra_s_na.text: Without Lyra's navigation, we're flying standard instruments through an environment where standard instruments are useless. Wind shear will throw off your vector. Lightning will fry your guidance. You're on your own, Darius.

dialogue_scenes_darius_wake_up_soon_star.speaker: darius
dialogue_scenes_darius_wake_up_soon_star.text: Wake up soon, starlight. I don't know how to do this without you.

banter_db_darius_lyra_hold_on_i_m_cleari.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_lyra_hold_on_i_m_cleari.text: Lyra! Hold on, I'm clearing the comm interference. Retreating!

banter_db_thorne_purge_engines_now_naya_.speaker: thorne
banter_db_thorne_purge_engines_now_naya_.text: Purge engines now, Naya. I'll blast the calcified nodes off your hull.

banter_db_darius_lyra_break_the_link_i_m.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_lyra_break_the_link_i_m.text: Lyra, break the link! I'm moving in, pulling out now!

banter_db_naya_thorne_watch_your_radar_t.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_thorne_watch_your_radar_t.text: Thorne, watch your radar! There's a second shelf below!

banter_db_naya_lyra_baby_listen_to_mom_s.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_lyra_baby_listen_to_mom_s.text: Lyra, baby, listen to Mom's voice. I'm pulling your ship out of the nebula.

banter_db_darius_lyra_i_m_here_comms_are.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_lyra_i_m_here_comms_are.text: Lyra, I'm here! Comms are down due to the flare, I'm pulling back to you!

banter_db_thorne_valera_eject_your_heats.speaker: thorne
banter_db_thorne_valera_eject_your_heats.text: Valera, eject your heatsinks. I'll cover your retreat.

banter_db_darius_lyra_close_the_audio_fe.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_lyra_close_the_audio_fe.text: Lyra, close the audio feed! I'm pulling us out of the storm!

banter_db_naya_lyra_he_s_wrong_baby_you_.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_lyra_he_s_wrong_baby_you_.text: Lyra! He's wrong, baby. You're my daughter. I'm pulling you out of the network.

banter_db_naya_darius_don_t_look_at_it_i.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_darius_don_t_look_at_it_i.text: Darius, don't look at it! I'm pulling you back, follow my ship!

banter_db_darius_lyra_hold_on_to_my_hand.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_lyra_hold_on_to_my_hand.text: Lyra, hold on to my hand. We're breaking the link and pulling out!

banter_db_cross_it_s_an_illusion_naya_br.speaker: cross
banter_db_cross_it_s_an_illusion_naya_br.text: It's an illusion, Naya. Break the synaptic link. Regroup at the beacon.

banter_db_darius_lyra_look_at_me_only_me.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_lyra_look_at_me_only_me.text: Lyra, look at me. Only me. We're pulling back to the rift edge.

banter_db_darius_grandpa_didn_t_just_fin.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_grandpa_didn_t_just_fin.text: Grandpa didn't just find the hatchery on Europa... he helped build the neural interface.

banter_db_naya_the_forge_mind_isn_t_buil.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_the_forge_mind_isn_t_buil.text: The Forge-Mind isn't building defenders for Earth. It's building an armada for the Architect.

banter_db_lyra_she_s_crying_because_she_.speaker: lyra
banter_db_lyra_she_s_crying_because_she_.text: She's crying because she knows what happens at the end of the universe, Daddy.

banter_db_darius_we_re_bending_spacetime.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_we_re_bending_spacetime.text: We're bending spacetime back on itself. Push through the paradox fog.

banter_db_lyra_we_promised_we_d_come_bac.speaker: lyra
banter_db_lyra_we_promised_we_d_come_bac.text: We promised we'd come back and free her song. Time to keep that promise.

banter_db_darius_we_re_going_to_break_th.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_we_re_going_to_break_th.text: We're going to break the synaptic web for good this time.

banter_engine_darius_that_s_a_decent_hau.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_that_s_a_decent_hau.text: That's a decent haul. Keep the momentum.

banter_engine_darius_better_gear_the_dee.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_better_gear_the_dee.text: Better gear. The deep doesn't get easier.

banter_engine_darius_welcome_aboard_we_v.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_welcome_aboard_we_v.text: Welcome aboard. We've got a long dive ahead.

banter_engine_darius_it_s_about_time_let.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_it_s_about_time_let.text: It's about time! Let's finish this.

banter_engine_darius_welcome_we_re_at_th.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_welcome_we_re_at_th.text: Welcome! We're at the final push. Every gun counts.

banter_engine_darius_they_ll_be_back_we_.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_they_ll_be_back_we_.text: They'll be back. We keep going.

banter_engine_darius_we_re_still_standin.speaker: darius
banter_engine_darius_we_re_still_standin.text: We're still standing. That's what matters.

banter_engine_naya_they_fought_well_now_.speaker: naya
banter_engine_naya_they_fought_well_now_.text: They fought well. Now it's on us.

briefing_lyra_daddy_it_s_beautiful_and_i.speaker: lyra
briefing_lyra_daddy_it_s_beautiful_and_i.text: Daddy — it's beautiful. And it's so, so old. It's not evil. It's just... guarding something. Something the Dreamer left behind. Please don't hurt it if you don't have to.

audio_tunnel_thorne_darius_you_reading_m.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_darius_you_reading_m.text: Darius. You reading me? The trench opening is dead ahead.

audio_tunnel_naya_scanners_online_abyssa.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_scanners_online_abyssa.text: Scanners online. Abyssal Trench — pressure's reading extreme. Stay sharp.

audio_tunnel_lyra_i_i_feel_something_ahe.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_i_i_feel_something_ahe.text: I... I feel something ahead. Old. Sleeping.

audio_tunnel_naya_coral_graveyard_navy_c.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_coral_graveyard_navy_c.text: Coral Graveyard. Navy census says it's a dead reef. Lyra, what are you picking up?

audio_tunnel_thorne_census_was_wrong_the.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_census_was_wrong_the.text: Census was wrong. The reef is active — and it's not coral. Stay in formation.

audio_tunnel_lyra_it_s_it_s_the_dreamer_.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_it_s_it_s_the_dreamer_.text: It's... it's the Dreamer's bones. This whole place is a graveyard of something ancient.

audio_tunnel_thorne_rust_wastes_ahead_ol.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_rust_wastes_ahead_ol.text: Rust Wastes ahead. Old Navy salvage fields — high radiation, low visibility.

audio_tunnel_naya_i_m_reading_navy_distr.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_i_m_reading_navy_distr.text: I'm reading Navy distress beacons. Old ones. Pre-war.

audio_tunnel_darius_ignore_them_navy_doe.speaker: darius
audio_tunnel_darius_ignore_them_navy_doe.text: Ignore them. Navy doesn't come back for their own. We're here for salvage, not ghosts.

audio_tunnel_naya_fire_nebula_temperatur.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_fire_nebula_temperatur.text: Fire Nebula. Temperature's spiking — shields at 100% but that won't last.

audio_tunnel_lyra_there_s_something_in_t.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_there_s_something_in_t.text: There's something in the fire. Not heat — consciousness. The Dreamer is awake here.

audio_tunnel_thorne_if_the_dreamer_s_tal.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_if_the_dreamer_s_tal.text: If the Dreamer's talking, listen. That thing predates the Navy by millennia.

audio_tunnel_darius_then_let_s_hear_what.speaker: darius
audio_tunnel_darius_then_let_s_hear_what.text: Then let's hear what it has to say. Full burn through the nebula.

audio_tunnel_naya_ice_shelf_temperature_.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_ice_shelf_temperature_.text: Ice Shelf. Temperature's bottoming out — weapons might ice up.

audio_tunnel_thorne_keep_the_engines_hot.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_keep_the_engines_hot.text: Keep the engines hot. You freeze in the Shelf, you don't thaw.

audio_tunnel_lyra_i_see_ships_in_the_ice.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_i_see_ships_in_the_ice.text: I see ships in the ice. Navy destroyers, frozen mid-battle. They were fighting something.

audio_tunnel_lyra_it_s_beautiful_biolume.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_it_s_beautiful_biolume.text: It's beautiful... Biolume Depths. The Dreamer's light.

audio_tunnel_naya_don_t_let_the_pretty_l.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_don_t_let_the_pretty_l.text: Don't let the pretty lights fool you. Biolume attracts predators.

audio_tunnel_thorne_naya_s_right_biolume.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_naya_s_right_biolume.text: Naya's right. Biolume means biomass — and biomass means teeth. Stay tight.

audio_tunnel_thorne_void_edge_this_is_wh.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_void_edge_this_is_wh.text: Void Edge. This is where the trench stops and... nothing starts.

audio_tunnel_lyra_the_dreamer_it_s_scare.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_the_dreamer_it_s_scare.text: The Dreamer... it's scared. The Void isn't empty — it's waiting.

audio_tunnel_naya_proximity_alert_someth.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_proximity_alert_someth.text: Proximity alert! Something's in the Void with us!

audio_tunnel_thorne_navy_shadow_fleet_th.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_navy_shadow_fleet_th.text: Navy shadow fleet. They've been following us since the Shelf. Ambush formation!

audio_tunnel_naya_gravity_rift_hold_onto.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_gravity_rift_hold_onto.text: Gravity Rift. Hold onto something — flight dynamics are going to get weird.

audio_tunnel_lyra_the_dreamer_says_let_g.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_the_dreamer_says_let_g.text: The Dreamer says... let go. Let gravity take us.

audio_tunnel_darius_trust_the_navigator_.speaker: darius
audio_tunnel_darius_trust_the_navigator_.text: Trust the Navigator. Cut engines — drift protocol.

audio_tunnel_thorne_time_sink_navy_lost_.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_time_sink_navy_lost_.text: Time Sink. Navy lost three destroyers here. Chronology errors in their black boxes.

audio_tunnel_lyra_i_can_see_us_past_runs.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_i_can_see_us_past_runs.text: I can see... us. Past runs. Future runs. They all converge here.

audio_tunnel_naya_if_lyra_s_seeing_timel.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_if_lyra_s_seeing_timel.text: If Lyra's seeing timelines, we're close to the Dreamer's core. Stay on her signal.

audio_tunnel_darius_every_run_every_deat.speaker: darius
audio_tunnel_darius_every_run_every_deat.text: Every run, every death — it all leads here. We finish this.

audio_tunnel_lyra_this_is_it_abyss_core_.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_this_is_it_abyss_core_.text: This is it. Abyss Core. The Dreamer's... no, the CREATOR'S heart.

audio_tunnel_thorne_all_hands_this_is_th.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_all_hands_this_is_th.text: All hands: this is the final push. Whatever's in that core — it's why the Navy burned a fleet here.

audio_tunnel_naya_darius_whatever_choice.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_darius_whatever_choice.text: Darius... whatever choice you make here, we're with you. All the way.

audio_tunnel_lyra_dad_i_can_see_the_endi.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_dad_i_can_see_the_endi.text: Dad... I can see the endings. Three of them. You have to choose.

audio_tunnel_darius_then_let_s_write_the.speaker: darius
audio_tunnel_darius_then_let_s_write_the.text: Then let's write the right one. Full power to all systems. We end this.

audio_tunnel_lyra_it_s_done_the_dreamer_.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_it_s_done_the_dreamer_.text: It's done. The Dreamer... it's free.

audio_tunnel_naya_we_did_it_against_ever.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_we_did_it_against_ever.text: We did it. Against everything the Navy threw at us — we made it.

audio_tunnel_thorne_mission_complete_all.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_mission_complete_all.text: Mission complete. All craft: status report. We're going home.

audio_tunnel_darius_not_home_forward_the.speaker: darius
audio_tunnel_darius_not_home_forward_the.text: Not home. Forward. There's still work to do.

audio_tunnel_lyra_wait_the_dreamer_says_.speaker: lyra
audio_tunnel_lyra_wait_the_dreamer_says_.text: Wait — the Dreamer says there's MORE. Beneath the core. The Reverse Abyss.

audio_tunnel_thorne_a_reverse_run_throug.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_a_reverse_run_throug.text: A reverse run? Through the Abyss backwards? That's suicide.

audio_tunnel_darius_suicide_was_the_firs.speaker: darius
audio_tunnel_darius_suicide_was_the_firs.text: Suicide was the first run. This is NG+. We go deeper.

audio_tunnel_naya_rescue_successful_all_.speaker: naya
audio_tunnel_naya_rescue_successful_all_.text: Rescue successful! All squad members accounted for.

audio_tunnel_thorne_good_work_nobody_get.speaker: thorne
audio_tunnel_thorne_good_work_nobody_get.text: Good work. Nobody gets left behind in my trench.

audio_tunnel_darius_we_re_stronger_toget.speaker: darius
audio_tunnel_darius_we_re_stronger_toget.text: We're stronger together. Let's finish this.

dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_the_nyx.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_the_nyx.text: [NARRATIVE] The Nyxa boosts through a tight center channel. Behind you, the left channel erupts in a blowout! Superheated vents erupt in massive flares.

dialogue_scenes_selene_warning_thermal_v.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_warning_thermal_v.text: [WARNING] Thermal vents blowing! Massive thermal surge detected. Direct hit! Shield integrity damaged!

dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_the_cor.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_the_cor.text: [NARRATIVE] The coral maze begins to collapse as the Memory Wraith's death throes destabilize the sector. Bedrock shuddering.

dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_the_nyx.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_the_nyx.text: [NARRATIVE] The Nyxa plunges into what looks like solid coral bedrock—and passes right through! A illusionary membrane of psychic static reveals a hidden current tunnel.

dialogue_scenes_selene_warning_debris_co.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_warning_debris_co.text: [WARNING] Debris collision! Substrate collapse! Hull damage sustained!

dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_the_nyx.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_the_nyx.text: [NARRATIVE] The Nyxa flies straight at the ice shard's surface. At the last possible moment, a fissure opens, bioluminescent Dreamer-matter pulsing. The ship slides through as Cross's torpedoes detonate harmlessly against the ice.

dialogue_scenes_selene_warning_incoming_.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_warning_incoming_.text: [WARNING] Incoming Umbra squad! Tactical ambush! Taking fire!

dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_darius_.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_darius_.text: [NARRATIVE] Darius plunges the damaged Nyxa into the ice shard fissure, escaping Cross's main squadron.

dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_navy_at.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_navy_at.text: [NARRATIVE] Navy attunement accelerator strike on Haven-7. Lyra has suffered neural overload and fallen into a deep coma.

dialogue_scenes_selene_effect_lyra_is_of.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_effect_lyra_is_of.text: [EFFECT] Lyra is offline. No navigator route warnings. Wind shear active. Lightning storm active.

dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_lyra_aw.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_narrative_lyra_aw.text: [NARRATIVE] Lyra awakens, her eyes glowing with a steady bioluminescent cyan light. A layered harmonic echo accompanies her voice.

dialogue_scenes_selene_effect_lyra_is_ba.speaker: selene
dialogue_scenes_selene_effect_lyra_is_ba.text: [EFFECT] Lyra is back online. Pathfinding overlay enabled.

banter_db_cross_edc_black_ops_intercept_.speaker: cross
banter_db_cross_edc_black_ops_intercept_.text: [EDC BLACK-OPS // INTERCEPT]: Mariana Trench was never an expedition—it was a quarantine zone for Prototype Alpha.

banter_db_naya_precursor_decrypt_the_gre.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_precursor_decrypt_the_gre.text: [PRECURSOR DECRYPT]: The Great Dying wasn't a plague. The Precursors chose crystallisation over surrender.

banter_db_naya_project_ophion_file_402_t.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_project_ophion_file_402_t.text: [PROJECT OPHION FILE 402]: The cybernetic genome was spliced from Darius's grandfather forty years ago.

banter_db_lyra_dreamer_cipher_the_veil_i.speaker: lyra
banter_db_lyra_dreamer_cipher_the_veil_i.text: [DREAMER CIPHER]: The Veil is not a gas cloud. It is the dreaming mind of the first Precursor Architect.

banter_db_cross_admiral_crane_directive_.speaker: cross
banter_db_cross_admiral_crane_directive_.text: [ADMIRAL CRANE DIRECTIVE 9]: All civilian craft passing Saturn rings are to be neutralized on sight.

banter_db_thorne_forge_mind_registry_sme.speaker: thorne
banter_db_thorne_forge_mind_registry_sme.text: [FORGE-MIND REGISTRY]: Smelter output reached 12,000 hulls per day before the overseers were terminated.

banter_db_selene_storm_singer_archive_he.speaker: selene
banter_db_selene_storm_singer_archive_he.text: [STORM-SINGER ARCHIVE]: Her acoustic song is a distress beacon broadcasting on frequencies older than stars.

banter_db_cross_flagship_goliath_purge_l.speaker: cross
banter_db_cross_flagship_goliath_purge_l.text: [FLAGSHIP GOLIATH PURGE LOG]: Admiral Crane digitized his consciousness 48 hours before the fleet fell.

banter_db_naya_synaptic_hive_genome_the_.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_synaptic_hive_genome_the_.text: [SYNAPTIC HIVE GENOME]: The Hive Mother was human once. The first test pilot to interface with the Coelacanth.

banter_db_architect_architect_omega_ciph.speaker: architect
banter_db_architect_architect_omega_ciph.text: [ARCHITECT OMEGA CIPHER]: The Cyber Coelacanth is the eternal reset button. Every timeline ends here.

banter_db_darius_timeline_echo_i_remembe.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_timeline_echo_i_remembe.text: [TIMELINE ECHO]: I remember this silt reef... we've flown this dive before in another life.

banter_db_naya_paradox_telemetry_crystal.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_paradox_telemetry_crystal.text: [PARADOX TELEMETRY]: Crystalline lattice resonance matches data from our previous campaign.

banter_db_darius_chrono_residual_europa_.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_chrono_residual_europa_.text: [CHRONO RESIDUAL]: Europa's ice feels familiar. We know every ambush coordinate.

banter_db_lyra_dreamer_recursion_the_sta.speaker: lyra
banter_db_lyra_dreamer_recursion_the_sta.text: [DREAMER RECURSION]: The stars in the Veil are singing the song from our previous victory!

banter_db_cross_umbra_deja_vu_crane_s_ri.speaker: cross
banter_db_cross_umbra_deja_vu_crane_s_ri.text: [UMBRA DEJA-VU]: Crane's ring blockade is tighter in this timeline, but we know the weak points.

banter_db_naya_foundry_echo_the_forge_mi.speaker: naya
banter_db_naya_foundry_echo_the_forge_mi.text: [FOUNDRY ECHO]: The Forge-Mind has upgraded its armor based on our last assault.

banter_db_selene_storm_singer_harmonic_t.speaker: selene
banter_db_selene_storm_singer_harmonic_t.text: [STORM-SINGER HARMONIC]: The tempest recognizes your ship signature, Vanguard.

banter_db_darius_ghost_fleet_paradox_cra.speaker: darius
banter_db_darius_ghost_fleet_paradox_cra.text: [GHOST FLEET PARADOX]: Crane's AI is panicking—his sensors show two iterations of us on radar.

banter_db_lyra_hive_memory_fracture_elen.speaker: lyra
banter_db_lyra_hive_memory_fracture_elen.text: [HIVE MEMORY FRACTURE]: Elena's mind is calling out clearer than before... she knows we're close.

banter_db_architect_architect_paradox_eq.speaker: architect
banter_db_architect_architect_paradox_eq.text: [ARCHITECT PARADOX EQUATION]: You return to the singularity... yet each return brings higher entropy...
